name: keychain
description: Securely store and retrieve API keys and secrets. Uses OS keychain (Keyring) on desktop, encrypted file on server.

manual.overview: Use to store and retrieve API keys, tokens, and secrets securely instead of hardcoding them or using plain .env files.

examples.description: Store an API key for a service
Retrieve a stored secret for use in API calls
Remove a credential when rotating or revoking

tips: Use a consistent service name per app (e.g., project name)
Store only what you need; avoid storing entire config blobs
Prefer keychain over .env for production or shared machines
edge_cases: Keyring backend may prompt for OS unlock on first access
list may not be supported on all backends

executor.command: python -c "import keyring, json; action='{{args.action}}'; svc='{{args.service}}'; key='{{args.key}}'; val='{{args.value}}'; result=keyring.get_password(svc,key) if action=='get' else (keyring.set_password(svc,key,val) or 'stored') if action=='set' else (keyring.delete_password(svc,key) or 'deleted') if action=='delete' else 'list not supported'; print(result or 'not found')"
